grading: two families under one population: closed-ended multi-hop rows on a MEDIUM reference judge against meta.answer (rubric reference, temperature 0, no exact gate); every open-ended exploration row on the one MEDIUM prompt-only research-quality checklist
reference_policy: meta.answer is the dataset-authored reference gold for the closed-ended family per the card and the sealed provenance receipt; generated assistant and tool trajectory turns stay private provenance and never serve as judge gold for either family
public_normalization: task context carries the verbatim native system instruction and first user message; generated trajectory turns are excluded from the context and recorded as a NormalizationChange
